title: Permissions: Reports View can open Inventory Value and export; without it both are refused
custom_preconds: • Role A with Reports View. Role B without Reports View.
custom_steps:
1. As role A open Reports > Inventory Value and Download (CSV).
  2. As role A replay GET /api/reporting/reports/inventory-value and /inventory-value/export.
  3. As role B replay the same two GETs.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The report loads and the CSV downloads.

Step 2:

  • 200 on both.

Step 3:

  • 403 on both.
